tools.name: open_end_get_pricing
tools.description: Returns the credit price list (1 credit = 1 valid response, charged once per project) and, with 'responses', how many credits an analysis of that many responses costs and the smallest sufficient credit package. tools.name: open_end_list_projects
tools.description: Lists the analysis projects the user already has (id, name, response count, whether credits were charged), newest first. tools.name: open_end_get_project
tools.description: Returns one project: research question, dataset (response counts), category hierarchies and the latest runs with their status. Use it to check what has already been done in a project before starting anything. Requires an API key.

tools.name: open_end_estimate_analysis
tools.description: Returns the credits the analysis of a project's responses will cost, whether credits were already charged, the user's available balance and the model and effort that will run. Always call it and show the user the price and model before open_end_start_run with type='hierarchy'. Charges nothing. Requi

tools.name: open_end_get_run
tools.description: Polls an analysis run started by open_end_start_run: status (pending, running, completed, failed), progress, stalled flag, error code and, when completed, the hierarchy_id for results. Runs take minutes; wait next_poll_after_seconds (10-30 s) between polls. Requires an API key.

tools.name: open_end_get_results
tools.description: Returns the finished code frame of a project: the L1-L3 category tree with descriptions, examples and how many responses fall into each category, plus summary counts and download URLs for XLSX/JSON/Markdown/DOCX exports (files are downloaded from the REST API with the same API key, not through MCP).

tools.name: open_end_create_project
tools.description: Creates an empty analysis project with a name and optionally the research question and context that guide the coding, and the output language of category names. Next step: open_end_add_responses. Creates nothing billable. Requires an API key with projects:write.

tools.name: open_end_add_responses
tools.description: Imports the open-ended responses (free-text answers or comments) of a project as JSON rows {id, text} (max 2000 rows per project via MCP, max 5000 characters each; empty texts are skipped as invalid). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: open_end_list_projects, open_end_get_results, open_end_add_responses · Private data: open_end_list_projects, open_end_get_project, open_end_estimate_analysis, open_end_get_run, open_end_get_results, open_end_create_project, open_end_add_responses, open_end_start_run · Public sink: open_end_add_responses · Destructive: open_end_estimate_analysis, open_end_get_run, open_end_start_run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: open_end_list_projects, open_end_get_results, open_end_add_responses · Private data: open_end_list_projects, open_end_get_project, open_end_estimate_analysis, open_end_get_run, open_end_get_results, open_end_create_project, open_end_add_responses, open_end_start_run · Public sink: open_end_add_responses · Destructive: open_end_estimate_analysis, open_end_get_run, open_end_start_run

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
